properties.name: WHAT WORKED (field log 2026-10-01 on 0.76.0, re-measured 2026-10-05 on 0.76.0, 0.78.0 and main): upstream_status works under --call. It walks a hub's declared pins and says `unchanged` or `moved` per member, and with external_dependency and compare_designs it was enough to pin a second member with no MCP. Do not regress it. Its limit (an export watch cannot see a member's unexported work) is recorded beside it
properties.statement:
Field log [works], 2026-10-01 (art:vscode-call-field-log-2026-10-05): "upstream_status works under --call: watched both hub pins and reported 'unchanged'", and "external_dependency + upstream_status + compare_designs were enough to pin a second member (nsls2.ioc_deploy) from the hub with no MCP."

RE-MEASURED, --call, scratch hub and child: external_dependency dep:child (design_export) exited 0. upstream_status gave `[dep:child unchanged]` on all three binaries. After a child write that re-exported (0.78.0 and main, with --export-to), it gave `moved`. The limit the same log reports, an export watch over unexported work, is fact:recurrence-an-export-watch-reads-unchanged-over-a-members-unexported-work-2026-10-05.
